name: Drawing
summary: Drawing majors focus on the foundational art of drawing in media such as graphite, charcoal, ink, and digital tools. Students develop observational skill, expressive range, and a personal visual language.
description: Drawing is the basis of most visual arts, and a drawing concentration develops it into a primary artistic practice. Students study observational drawing, perspective, anatomy and figure drawing, and composition, then explore experimental and conceptual approaches, large-scale work, and drawing as part of installation, animation, or printmaking. Digital drawing tools are often included. Critiques, art history, and contemporary art courses help students situate their work, and a senior exhibition or portfolio caps the program. The skills transfer directly to illustration, concept art, animation, and design, as well as fine art careers.
